appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How the dashboard looks. This is saved in this browser, so it does not follow you to another device.
appearance.hint: The sun and moon button in the top bar sets Light or Dark directly. Choose one of those here to go back to following your system.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: What this workspace's files use, across every project. Files synced from your computer or from cloud storage count, and so do agent and workflow outputs.
storage.hint: Delete files you no longer need, or move the workspace to a bigger plan.

export.unavailable: Downloading a copy of your data isn't available on this server. Ask the person who runs it for a copy.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Close your ReelBolt account and remove what it holds.
deleteAccount.summary: You're signed out everywhere straight away, and your projects, files, runs and chats are removed after {days} days. Sign in any time before then and the deletion is cancelled — nothing is lost.
deleteAccount.notes: If you're the only owner of a team that still has other members, hand the team over first. A paid plan isn't cancelled for you: cancel it from <link>Plan & billing</link> → Cancel plan before you go. Want a copy of your data? Download it above first.
deleteAccount.modalBody: Your account will be scheduled for deletion and you'll be signed out on every device. You have {days} days to change your mind by signing in again.
deleteAccount.passwordHint: To make sure it’s really you.
deleteAccount.useProvider: I sign in with Google or GitHub
deleteAccount.providerNote: You'll confirm by signing in with Google or GitHub instead of a password. Nothing is deleted until you come back from that sign-in.

outcome.wrongPassword: That password isn't right. Try again.
outcome.passwordRequired: This account signs in with a password. Enter it above to continue.
outcome.soleOwner: You're the only owner of “{team}”, which still has other members. Make someone else an owner or remove the members first: switch to that team with the workspace switcher, then open <link>Workspace → Members</link>. Nothing has been deleted.
outcome.providerBody: Nothing has been deleted yet. Sign in with {name} to prove the account is yours; your account is scheduled for deletion when you come back.
outcome.unavailable: Signing in with Google or GitHub isn't set up on this server, so it can't confirm the deletion. Set a password with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page, then come back and use it here.
outcome.signedOut: You've been signed out. Sign in again, then come back here.
outcome.failed: Something went wrong and your account was not deleted. Please try again in a moment.

page.title: Account
page.intro: Your account, and where to find this workspace's usage and plan. Changes here apply to you and follow you between workspaces; the workspace's own settings stay under Workspace.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Who you are signed in as. These come from your session.
profile.roleHint: Your role in this workspace is changed by an Owner or Admin on <link>Workspace → Members</link>.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.body: The workspace you are in right now is set by the switcher at the top of the left menu. What it has used and what it is on are on <usage>Usage</usage> and <billing>Plan & billing</billing>.

security.passwordDescription: Changing it signs you out of your other devices.
security.toolsDescription: ReelBolt does not use personal API keys, so there is nothing to create or copy here.
security.toolsBody: An AI agent such as Claude Code connects over MCP by opening a ReelBolt sign-in in your browser and asking for your approval. It acts as you, with your workspace's limits, and you can stop it by changing your password.

page.notificationsNote: Emails about your own jobs finishing or failing are on the <link>Notifications</link> page.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Take a copy of everything ReelBolt holds about you, or close your account.

notifications.title: Notifications

jobSucceeded.label: Job finished
jobSucceeded.description: An email when a video job you started finishes successfully.

jobFailed.label: Job failed
jobFailed.description: An email when a video job you started fails, including the reason it failed.

fileCreated.label: File added
fileCreated.description: An email when a file is added to a project in your workspace.

graphicsEdited.label: Thumbnail graphic edited
graphicsEdited.description: An email when a thumbnail graphic in a project in your workspace is edited.

reviewActivity.label: Review activity
reviewActivity.description: Email me when someone leaves a note or a decision on a review link I shared.

avatarRetention.label: Avatar about to be deleted
avatarRetention.description: Email me a week before an avatar I made is deleted because its keep-for period ends, so I can renew it.

socialPublishing.label: Social publishing
socialPublishing.description: Email me when a post I made is published or fails, or when a connected account needs reconnecting.

notifications.saveFailed: Your change could not be saved. The switch is back to how it was. Try again.
notifications.loadFailed: Could not load your notification settings. Try again.

recent.title: Recent activity
recent.description: The latest emails you were sent, newest first. A red dot means the send failed.
recent.empty: Nothing here yet. When a job finishes or a file is added, you’ll see it.

usage.title: Usage

axisPhrase.model: by the model that did the work
axisPhrase.source: by what the credits were spent on

noBilling.title: Billing is not enabled on this deployment
noBilling.body: This deployment runs without billing, so it does not keep a credit balance or charge for usage. Nothing is wrong with your account: the usage and credits view is simply switched off here. Nothing you do on this page has been metered or charged.

loadFailed.title: Could not load your usage
loadFailed.fallback: Please try again in a moment.

usage.intro: Every call the platform makes on your behalf is recorded with what it consumed, which provider and model did the work, and the credits it was charged. The charge is priced when the call runs, so a later price change never rewrites what you were billed.

breakdown.title: Breakdown
breakdown.empty: No metered usage in the last {days} days. Runs, uploads and assistant answers all write a record here, so an empty list means nothing has been metered yet.
breakdown.showing: Showing {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, grouped {axis}. “Metered calls” counts recorded calls, not steps: one step can make several calls.

credits.heldLine: {balance} in the account · {reserved} held for running work

totals.calls: {events, plural, one {# metered call} other {# metered calls}} in the last {days} days

whoPays.title: Who paid the provider
whoPays.note: Work on your own providers or runners is charged at the platform rate, never at the provider's own price.

emailChange.title: Email change pending
emailChange.body: We are waiting for you to confirm {email} from your current address. The request expires on {date}.
emailChange.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the change. Please try again.

mcpMediaEgress.title: Media and connected tools (MCP)
mcpMediaEgress.description: Lets a tool connected through MCP allow sending your media to outside AI model providers (other companies) for one action at a time: a run it starts, a clip that shows your avatars and objects, a variant made with AI, an object pulled out of a video, or a picture. Each action must still ask for it, and a run's record shows who allowed it. Off by default.
mcpMediaEgress.saveFailed: Could not save. Your change was not applied.
mcpMediaEgress.loadFailed: Could not load this setting. Try again.
mcpMediaEgress.switchLabel: Let connected tools (MCP) allow sending my media to outside AI model providers (other companies)
mcpMediaEgress.stateOn: On: a connected tool can allow sending your media for a run, a clip, a variant, an object or a picture.
mcpMediaEgress.stateOff: Off: a connected tool cannot allow sending your media.
